scope: Exact reviewed corporate seller-name associations only; neither legal succession nor construction of the current home is inferred.
normalization: Uppercase, collapse whitespace, remove periods and commas. All remaining names must match a listed alias in full.

limits.burnstead: Initial collection covers three exact LLC names in 2010–2026 county transactions. Earlier corporations, Steven/Steve substitutions, truncated names, other affiliates and combined sellers await review. A current company document does not establish retrospective legal continuity.
limits.quadrant: Initial collection covers five reviewed corporate-name forms through 2020. Misspellings, other entities, combined sellers and 2021 onward transactions await review. Tri Pointe successor transactions are not automatically attributed to the historical Quadrant brand.
